verification.notes: The U.S. military does conduct psychological/information operations, and independent researchers documented coordinated inauthentic accounts advancing pro-U.S./Western foreign-policy narratives in the Middle East and Central Asia. records.text: The moon landing and the Manson murders were military operations.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And in 1969, lo and behold, speaking of. Speaking of the book Chaos, when the military was just spiking the ball, psychological operations, moon landing, whenever you're ready, the Manson murders, whenever you're ready, all military.

verification.notes: NASA's mission history and report document Apollo 11 as a NASA lunar-landing mission, not a covert military operation. Reporting on renewed Manson theories notes links and unanswered questions around government programs but explicitly says the principal investigator found no direct evidence that the murders were a CIA or military operation. The compound categorical claim therefore overstates available evidence.

sources.relevance: Official NASA history documents the lunar landing as the Apollo 11 civilian space mission.

verification.notes: Fort Huachuca officially hosts the U.S. Army Intelligence Center of Excellence and describes intelligence development, testing, doctrine, and training as core missions. Historical reporting confirms at least one major Army day-care abuse investigation linked to personnel associated with the post, but 'has had many scandals' is too vague and unbounded to verify as stated; the transcript also overgeneralizes the installation as the home of all Army psychological operations.

sources.title: U.S. Army Intelligence Center of Excellence — Fort Huachuca

records.text: Pornography is part of a psychological operation and renders men weaker.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I stand against pornography as a Catholic and you should, too, because that's a part of a psychological operation. It renders men weaker.

verification.notes: Systematic reviews find associations between problematic pornography use and some adverse mental-health or sexual-health outcomes, but emphasize heterogeneous evidence, self-reporting, and limited ability to infer causation. No credible evidence reviewed establishes pornography as a coordinated psychological operation, and 'renders men weaker' is too vague to measure as stated.

sources.title: Gender differences in pornography use and sexual health outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
sources.relevance: Reviews observed sexual-health and psychological associations while emphasizing heterogeneity and limited causal inference.
